label: Bhapa doi
note: Not fermented at the pot: hung curd is whisked with sweetened condensed milk and cardamom, then steamed and chilled. A dessert made FROM yoghurt, so a different arrow.

about.text: Bengali steamed yoghurt dessert: thick hung curd is mixed with sweetened condensed milk, cardamom and often saffron, steamed in small bowls for about 20 minutes and chilled until it sets like a soft cheesecake. Traditional versions sweeten with nolen gur, date-palm jaggery.
